notes.title: Developer Interview
notes.notes:
Good day, detectives! We talked to the CEO of Genuine Studio, the amazing developer of Detective Kobayashi, and had him answer some questions for all of you to give you a little insight into the work on this IP!

[b]What inspired you to create this game?[/b]
It has been quite some time since I created the character Kobayashi - it was over 17 years ago. I used to write detective cases while I was in college and Kobayashi was always the detective in my stories.
I was planning to publish a novel 6 years ago with all the cases I had written until then, but that year I met an artist who suggested to make games based on my stories. That’s how I jumped into this field and started creating visual novels.

[b]What were some challenges (in the development)?[/b]
It can be tough, since me and my business partner didn’t know anything about game development before then, so we started from scratch and there were a lot of technical difficulties to overcome. We needed to make compromises and often had different opinions on how to solve things and develop the series.

[b]Who is your favorite character?[/b]
Matsuda! Of course I love Kobayashi, but Matsuda is the perfect assistant. She’s smart, agile, sexy and has a kind heart. This made writing the scenes between her and the detective a lot of fun.

[b]What are your favorite games/genre in general?[/b]
Final Fantasy, The Witcher series, Tokimeki Memorial and some simulation games back in the PS1 genre. But I do play lots of visual novel games, Phoenix Wright is also one of my favorites.

[b]Which features are you most proud of?[/b]
I think the light bulb system. In the beta version of this game, the light bulb system did not yet exist, and I was wondering what could be added to make the characters more alive. So this light bulb idea popped into my head and we spent an extra month developing this feature. Kobayashi’s thoughts really helped people understand and love this character more.
Apart from that the SMS system is also fun since players can discover different phone numbers throughout the game, adding contacts and trying to chit-chat with different characters. This sets the game apart from others of the genre. 

[b]What’s the best thing about being a game developer?[/b]
Aside from being a game developer, I’m also a storyteller and it’s great to see my stories being visualized. We all have good memories of our favorite games when we were kids, so the feeling of making games like that yourself is priceless.

notes.title: We're live!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Kobayashi's world, detectives! We call on you to join us in the fight against crime and band together to defeat the forces of evil that threaten the peace and quiet of Hong Kong! Kobayashi would much rather be playing games or meeting cute girls, but alas, duty calls! The first case has just come in and the police department is at a loss.....but never fear - our nerdy detective is here!

notes.title: Welcome, detectives!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35027825/c361c57a626365c990efef82cf240821d62cffdc.png[/img]

Welcome, detectives!!

Great to have you on board! We're Giiku Games, your publisher for Anime and Asian Games worldwide! Join the giikdom and follow us for game updates, discussions and some tricky investigations...

...because we're bringing our favourite detective - Kobayashi - to Steam this Summer! Witty dialogues, unsolveable mysteries, an intelligent nemesis and a cute colleague - the perfect ingredients for a one-of-a-kind Anime visual novel, wouldn't you say?

Now, with great genius comes great responsibility, and as much as Kobayashi tries to hide it, his work motivation and social skills...leave something to be desired. Join him on an adventure that will leave you questioning whether gaming at the office can be pulled off as research, whether a murder case can be solved in time for the special evening episode of "Wok of Love" and how a security guy came to think he's a superhero.

Stay tuned!
